fieldValues.title: Is any cross-repository graph needed before RFC-049 is accepted?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised as an open question in Research (5. The graph across repositories), 2026-10-30, and turned into an exercise so options are explored before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Wait for RFC-049 and the ratified order of federation's return.
- B. A read-only view across repositories, resolved client-side, as a probe.
- C. Prototype cross-repository links in clients now and feed the RFC.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Concrete documents that need a link into another repository, and how often.
fieldValues.next_action: Collect the cases behind SP-86 and SP-87 and check which an addressing-only RFC-049 already covers.
